tm.「{var:1}よ 見事な戦いぶりだったぞ。\n これで {var:8}手以内に: "{var:1}, you fought splendidly. If you defeated the enemies within {var:8} moves, you pass the trial. Now, the result this time is..."
tm.「残念っ！ {var:9}手も かかってしまった。\n これでは 恐怖に打ち勝っ: "Too bad! It took {var:9} moves. I can't say you've conquered your fear. I cannot grant your wish."

tm.「さあ 約束通り お前の願いを\n ひとつ かなえてやろう！\n かなえてほしい: "Now, as promised, I will grant you one wish! Choose the wish you want granted."

tm.「さすがは 勇者 {var:1}！\n まこと 勇者に ふさわしい願いであること: "As expected of Luminary {var:1}! A wish truly worthy of a Luminary! Then I bestow this recipe upon you!"

tm.「……ふむ そうか。謙虚なヤツだな。\n しかし 強さのみを求める ストイックな: "...Hm, I see. How modest. But that stoic attitude of seeking only strength... I don't dislike it..."
